title_en: Fall 2026 Registration for Remote Courses with Credit Recognition During Military Service
summary: Eligible students serving in the military who wish to take remote courses for credit recognition in Fall 2026 must register through '장병e음' (Janghwang e-eum) between 18:00 on 12 August 2026 and 24:00 on 17 September 2026. Students may take up to 6 credits per semester (12 credits in total during service), at a fee of KRW 40,500 per credit. After returning to school, students must apply for credit recognition on mySNU before the last day of classes of the semester in which they return.
applies_to: Eligible students currently serving in the military who wish to take remote courses for credit recognition in Fall 2026. Participation is optional. Students who are discharged or released from service before the one-quarter point of the semester (23 September 2026) cannot apply. The detailed eligibility criteria may be in the attachment, which was not read.

dates.when: From 18:00 on Wednesday, 12 August 2026 to 24:00 on Thursday, 17 September 2026

conditions: Students may register for no more than 6 credits per semester and no more than 12 credits in total during their period of service.
Course registration, changes and cancellations can be made only through '장병e음'.
Students who are discharged or released from service before the one-quarter point of the semester (23 September 2026) cannot apply.
A regular course cannot be retaken as a remote course; such applications will not be approved.
Completed credits are recognised as earned credits only after approval, and they are not included in the grade point average.
Credit recognition must be applied for on mySNU before the last day of classes of the semester of return.
steps: Read the attachment '[붙임] 2026학년도 2학기 군복무 학점인정 원격수업 수강신청 안내' (Fall 2026 Registration for Remote Courses with Credit Recognition During Military Service); its contents were not read for this translation.

Register for remote courses (up to 6 credits this semester, within the 12-credit total limit during service) on '장병e음' between 18:00 on 12 August 2026 and 24:00 on 17 September 2026; make any changes or cancellations on '장병e음' as well.
Pay the tuition of KRW 40,500 per credit (the payment method is not stated in the notice text).
After returning to school, apply for credit recognition on mySNU before the last day of classes of the semester in which you return.
translation:
Fall 2026 Registration for Remote Courses with Credit Recognition During Military Service [2026학년도 2학기 군복무 학점인정 원격수업 수강신청 안내]

We announce the course registration schedule and other details for remote courses with credit recognition during military service for Fall 2026. Eligible students who wish to take these courses are asked to complete their registration within the period.

1. Course registration period: 12 August 2026 (Wed) 18:00 to 17 September 2026 (Thu) 24:00

2. Credits: no more than 6 credits per semester, and no more than 12 credits in total during the period of service

3. Tuition: KRW 40,500 per credit

4. Credit recognition: apply on mySNU before the last day of classes of the semester in which you return to school

5. Important notes
A. Course registration (including changes and cancellations) is possible only through '장병e음'.
B. Students who are discharged or released from service before the one-quarter point of the semester (23 September 2026 (Wed)) cannot apply.
C. A regular course cannot be retaken as a remote course; such applications will not be approved.
D. Completed credits are recognised as earned credits after approval, but they are not included in the grade point average.
